_comment: Data-driven links between Urheimat hypotheses and the migration routes each one implies (US-002). `byFamily` maps a language-family id to the migration-route ids that carry that family's expansion; `byHypothesis` (optional) overrides the family set for a specific competing hypothesis so switching hypotheses can change which routes light up. Route ids match lexicons/migration-routes.tsv; family ids match lexicons/urheimat-hypotheses.tsv `language_family_id`. Adding a link needs no code change.
